# Whether a module can be packed as a plain `lib/modules/<module>.jar` is a repo-global AND over every

# the community modules a community-only checkout would fold differently, because the reports that decide them
# are in the ultimate half: `+` is a candidate, `-` is not, and the sign is the whole-repo answer either way.
